summary: @or-sdk/library preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package's `preinstall` script (`node setup.mjs`) runs automatically on `npm install`. If `bun` is not present on PATH, `setup.mjs` fetches the Bun runtime archive from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/<name>.zip`, extracts the `bun` binary to a temp directory, chmods it 0755, and invokes it against a 727KB bundled file `math_init.js` shipped in the tarball. Both `setup.mjs` and `math_init.js` are obfuscator.io-style obfuscated (hex identifier renaming such as `_0x488df8`/`_0x52943e`, shuffled string-array with rotation function `WV8StW`, string-lookup maps with random 5-letter keys). The package is advertised as a REST API SDK, and the obfuscated payload's purpose is not documented in the README or changelog; it is executed under a runtime deliberately chosen to bypass Node-based inspection. This matches the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern: installing the package causes execution of opaque, obfuscated code shipped alongside a downloaded alternate runtime.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
